QuestInfo.name: Interdimensional Travel Prep
QuestInfo.0: Go to #bFenelle#k in #bPantheon Great Temple Interior#k like Romero said.
QuestInfo.1: Fenelle says you have to be approved by #bBeldar#k and #bCartalion#k in #bPantheon#k before she'll trust that you're tough enough to travel.
QuestInfo.2: Beldar and Cartalion are satisfied you can take care of yourself... as if there was a doubt.

0.msg: #b(You tell Fenelle that the Shadowdealers sent you to her.)#k\r\n

1.msg: Ah, you're the... How did they put it? 'Goody two-shoes what's trying to save Grandis like a chump.'\r\n

2.msg: #b(Argh! You're never going to live this down. Those Heliseum jerks will pay...)#k\r\n

3.msg: Hm. There's something familiar about you? Have we met...?\r\n

4.msg: #b(...! Priests sometimes came to visit the castle. Does she recognize you from back then?!)#k\r\n

5.msg: No, no, that can't be right. I must have mistaken you for someone else. Please, forgive me and let's get to business.

6.msg: The Shadowdealers say that you're quite stalwart, but we don't know what dangers await in the new world. I would test your strength for my own piece of mind.\r\n

0.msg: #bBeldar#k and #bCartalion#k will test your abilities. You will find them to the right of the Great Temple.\r\n

1.msg: Once you have received permission from both of them, then I shall teach you how to use the Interdimensional Portal.\r\n

2.msg: #b(That was a close one. If this old bat nearly recognized you, someone else might, too. Be careful.)#k\r\n

0.msg: #b(This all sounds so complicated... Take some time to think things over.)#k\r\n
I see that both Beldar and Cartalion have given you their blessing. I accept their judgment.\r\n

1.msg: I shall show you how to use the Interdimensional Portal. Follow me, please.\r\n

2.msg: #b(It's really happening. A new world. But... can you really leave without at least telling the boss goodbye?)#k\r\n

3.msg: I, ah, forgot something. I'll be right back.\r\n

4.msg: I... see. I shall wait. For now.\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

default.0: I'll only let you use the gate if you get approval from #bBeldar#k and #bCartalion#k. You will find them just outside the Great Temple.\r\n
